verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships a SaaS AI product (Visalaw AI), so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question to ask. The only privacy evidence is a marketing claim of SOC 2 Type II certification and 'no data retention'. That concerns retention of client content, not a user-facing control to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking, and no such setting or policy is documented.
